basic_lead.eventDescription: One local business found on Google Maps with name, address, phone, category, and rating. Does not meet the enriched tier rules (no working website, or below the min-rating and min-reviews bars).

enriched_lead.eventDescription: One local business that passed all qualification rules: working website with valid MX record, rating at or above the configured minimum (default 4.0), review count at or above the configured minimum (default 10), and a phone. Includes likely contact email patterns. First 5 enriched leads per run are free so you can validate output.
